summary:
“McDean” is the fan name for Hollyoaks’ John Paul McQueen (James Sutton) and Craig Dean (Guy Burnet), a couple whose romance became one of the soap’s most successful stories and drew strong fan and LGBT-rights-group support.

John Paul arrives in 2006, struggling with his sexuality. He falls for Craig, his close friend, who has a girlfriend, Sarah, and resists defining his attraction to John Paul. Their secret affair grows alongside Craig’s relationship with Sarah. At Craig and Sarah’s engagement party, Sarah catches the men kissing and exposes the affair. The story also shows the hurt caused to Sarah.

Craig leaves for college in Dublin in 2007, and John Paul later has a relationship with priest Kieron Hobbs. Both actors then planned to leave Hollyoaks. Burnet returned in 2008, and the characters reunited before John Paul’s departure, receiving a happy “sunset ending.”

Burnet said he found the role difficult at first and wanted Craig’s sexuality to remain ambiguous; Sutton was comfortable portraying a gay character. Both praised their working relationship.
unsupportedClaims: Both actors planned to leave Hollyoaks only after Craig had left for Dublin and John Paul had become involved with the priest. Burnet had already decided to leave in 2007.
The priest's first name is spelled “Kieron”; the points spell it “Keiron.”
The happy reunion was a “sunset ending”; the points support the happy ending but not that label.
Sutton praised the actors' working relationship. The points support his praise of Burnet's acting and professionalism, but not of their working relationship itself.
